edge_sample.source_text: lemma Recurrence for $S_k$: For $\|q\| < 1$ and every $k$, \[ S_k - S_{k+1} \;=\; q^{\,k+1}\,\bigl(S_{k+2} - S_{k+1}\bigr). \]
edge_sample.target_text: theorem Key identity: For $\|q\| < 1$ and every $k$, $\;S_k(q) = 1/(q;q)_\infty$.

edge_sample.source_text: theorem Infinite $q$-binomial / Cauchy identity, restated for the formal development: For $a, z, q \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\|q\| < 1$ and $\|z\| < 1$, \[ \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{(a; q)_n}{(q; q)_n}\, z^n = \frac{(a z; q)_\infty}{(z; q)_\infty}. \] (Equivalent to Theorem~\ref{thm:qbin-infinite}.) edge_sample.target_text: lemma First Euler identity: For $\|q\| < 1$ and $\|z\| < 1$, \[ \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{z^n}{(q;q)_n} = \frac{1}{(z;q)_\infty}. \]

edge_sample.source_text: definition FPS key sum: For $k \in \mathbb{N}$, define \[ S^{\mathrm{fps}}_k \;:=\; \sum_{m=0}^{\infty} X^{m(m+k)} \cdot \bigl(\texttt{qPoch}(X,m)\bigr)^{-1} \cdot \bigl(\texttt{qPoch}(X,m+k)\bigr)^{-1} \;\in\; R[\![ X]\!]. \]
edge_sample.target_text: lemma FPS key sum recurrence: For every $k$: \[ S^{\mathrm{fps}}_k - S^{\mathrm{fps}}_{k+1} \;=\; X^{k+1}\cdot\bigl(S^{\mathrm{fps}}_{k+2} - S^{\mathrm{fps}}_{k+1}\bigr). \]
